reasoning_summary: Written inline by the coordinator session. Hyperbata left as fragments with the agreeing word in the note (4.9 interitura/verba, priores/sedes, Pindaricae/Camenae, comptos/crinis, lividas/obliviones, alto/voltu; 4.11 superantis/Albani, castis/verbenis, amanda/voce, atrae/curae; 4.13 decens/motus, nota/facies, brevis/annos, parem/Lycen; 4.14 tuas/virtutes, habitabilis/oras, horrendam/diluviem, optatum/decus; 4.15 parva/vela, superbis/postibus, vacuum/Ianum, Italae/vires, almae/Veneris). Subjects placed late are named in the notes (4.9.13-16 Helene; 4.11.21-22 puella; 4.14.45-46 Nilus). Negatives kept in place (4.9.5-9 non ... nec; 4.9.13-24 non sola ... non semel ... non ... non; 4.9.45 and 51; 4.12.3 nec ... nec; 4.12.22 non ego; 4.13.13-14 nec ... nec; 4.15.17-24 non ... non ... non ... non ... non ... non). Moods kept: ne credas (4.9.1), vocaveris potential (4.9.45), the future perfects of 4.10, ut noris / sequare / vites (4.11), reddas (4.11.35), ne darem (4.15.3). Supplied words noted (it 4.9.10 and 4.11.30, him 4.11.23). Names as in the Latin (Camenae, Ilios, Hister, Hiberia, Tanais, Liber, Quirinus); Iovi rendered Jove as in the other batches. 4.10.6-8 and 4.9 keep the source's quotation marks.
